intent: Define the structural dependency and governance relationships across the UBVM/SCP ecosystem, providing a machine-readable semantic map for humans, agents, and future UBVM tooling.

interpretation.this_is: The official UBVM dependency graph — a governance-adjacent semantic artefact that formalises how meaning, execution, and behaviour flow through the UBVM/SCP ecosystem.
purpose: Codify the dependency structure that governs the UBVM/SCP ecosystem
Provide a canonical navigational map for developers and AI agents
Enable future tooling to validate upstream/downstream compliance
Prevent semantic drift by making governance relationships explicit
Serve as the backbone for completeness audits and phase-gate enforcement
audience: AI agents reasoning about the ecosystem
importance: scp/spec as the root of all meaning
capsules as the behavioural leaf node
dont_change: Node hierarchy — scp/spec is always root
capsules as the only leaf node
ubvm/glossary as the only pure support node

relationship_types.governs: The upstream node defines rules the downstream node must obey. Violations produce non-compliance.
relationship_types.supports: The upstream node provides vocabulary or context the downstream node relies on, without imposing hard rules.
relationship_types.executes: The runtime interprets and runs the capsule's declared behaviours.
relationship_types.depends_on: The downstream node cannot be built, interpreted, or trusted without the upstream node being correct.

guarantees: scp/spec is always the root of the dependency graph.
capsules is always the leaf — it governs nothing and depends on everything above it.
ubvm/glossary supports but never governs — vocabulary anchors language, not law.
ubvm/roadmap governs ubvm/spec — phase gates are law for the 1.0 cut.
Any new artefact added to the ecosystem must declare its position in this graph.
This graph reduces ambiguity and prevents semantic drift across the suite.
non_guarantees: Implementation details of any individual node.
Runtime-specific behaviour of the UBVM interpreter.
semantic_contract.conflict_resolution: If contradictions arise about ecosystem structure, this dependency graph takes precedence over informal descriptions in README or code comments. For semantic rule conflicts, defer to scp/spec. For execution rule conflicts, defer to ubvm/spec.

provenance.author: James / Giblets Creations
provenance.context: Created during UBVM documentation session, May 2026. Formalises the dependency graph as a Thaumiel-class governance capsule after the semantic mesh reached full parity.
